properties.description:
This use case detects the attempt to exploit a DNS server misconfiguration in order to leak KPMG DNS records over a DNS Zone Transfer Transaction. 
A threat actor may send zone transfer queries to a misconfigured DNS server and subsequently get a copy of DNS records.
properties.query:
let TriggeredIPs =
SecurityAlert
| where DisplayName == "GO-PRD-SENTINEL-036 DNS Zone Transfer Attempt" 
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(24h)
| extend A = parse_json(Entities) 
| mvexpand A
| extend IP = tostring(A.Address)
| where isnotempty(IP)
| distinct IP;
dns
| where TimeGenerated > ago (10m)
| where IP !in (TriggeredIPs)
| where IP !in (vuln_scanner_IPs)
| where RawData matches regex @"]\s(A|I)XFR\s\s"        
| where QueryResponseIndicator =~ "R" 
| where Response !has "REFUSED"                      
| where  ipv4_is_private(IP) == false
| extend RecordType = "XFR"     
| project-rename ClientIP = IP
| union ( Infobloxdns
| where ClientIP !in (TriggeredIPs)
| where TimeGenerated > ago (10m)
| where RecordType in ("AXFR","IXFR")
| where isnotempty( Result)
| where Result != "REFUSED"
| extend EventTime = tostring(EventTime)
| where  ipv4_is_private(ClientIP) == false
| project-rename Response = Result)
| extend HostCustomEntity = HostName
| extend IPCustomEntity = ClientIP
| extend URLCustomEntity = Domain
